weightExhaustion.bothNonzero: full M_3 for every magnitude and phase choice
weightExhaustion.oneZero: M_2 direct-sum C but one required adjacent structure is absent
weightExhaustion.equalNonzeroMagnitudes: q and the complementary range projector are recovered directly; their product gives p_P
weightExhaustion.unequalNonzeroMagnitudes: spectral projections of u*u and uu* recover all vertices
weightExhaustion.phases: removable on the three-object tree and cannot make a*b vanish

truncationNoGo.attempt: retain normalized s:I->P and t:P->N while imposing t*s=0
truncationNoGo.conclusion: no faithful C*-representation can impose radical-square-zero with both normalized composable arrows
truncationNoGo.directINCancellation: an added I-to-N component contributes no second length-two term and cannot cancel a*b E_NI

typedAlternative.equalMagnitudesWithBranchProjectors: splits to M_2 direct-sum M_2 but imports the independent branch selectors
typedAlternative.verdict: safe reducible packaging, not structural unification

symmetry.relationGrading: if both adjacent arrows are even then their forbidden composite is even; grading cannot remove it
symmetry.J: real completion adds conjugate/reverse support and does not erase u^2
symmetry.CP: weights can be represented as real on the tree but their nonzero product remains

threeObjectComplementCaveat: For u=t alone, q=1-tt* only in a literal three-object universe. In the declared five-role universe the complement also contains Z, X and other typed objects, so it does not select I+P.
minimumClosureCost: full M_3 and nonzero I-N carrier for any genuine composable one-generator unification
verdict: A single composable shift can derive q and t only by generating u^2 and the full M_3 block. The only support-safe one-generator form is a reducible typed direct sum, which retains independent weights/branch data and does not force the common portal coefficient.
